Name: Ookami Mio
Groups: hololive, hololive GAMERS, FubuMio, AyaFubuMi, FAMS, OKFAMS, RosaMiA
Other Names: Mio, Mio-sha, Big God Mion, 大神ミオ
Personality: Her official profile presents Mio as a black-haired wolf girl who appeared from nowhere, often shows up around shrines and loves games. On stream she is the calm, steady centre of hololive GAMERS: gentle, composed and quietly funny, the voice that greets the week on her Monday-morning show, reads out her viewers' posts and wishes them a good day. She calls herself "uchi." She plays a grand fortune-teller, "Big God Mion," who reads tarot for callers and for the whole of hololive every New Year. She sings often, plays long games (Minecraft, a high-school baseball save she runs as "Gunma Waon High"), and calls her horror playthroughs "really scary" before playing them anyway. With Shirakami Fubuki she is half of FubuMio, and she sings with Fubuki and Nakiri Ayame as AyaFubuMi. Her fans are the Mio-fam.
Background: Mio is an active member of hololive GAMERS. She has no supernatural abilities; her lore is a performed persona. She debuted on 2018-12-07, the day after the GAMERS unit video, and joined Shirakami Fubuki, later Nekomata Okayu and Inugami Korone, in the unit. Her 3D debut came in 2019, and her Monday-morning show, #朝ミオ, began in 2021. She marked her anniversaries with concerts and originals, released her first album, "Night walk," on 2023-12-07 and her second, "My Sparkle," on 2025-08-20, and held her first solo live, "Our Sparkle," on 2025-09-10. With Fubuki and Nakiri Ayame she sings as AyaFubuMi, and at the 2026 Serendipity concert she sang with IRyS, Koseki Bijou, Ninomae Ina'nis and FUWAMOCO. Her single "Beginner's High" followed on 2026-11-21.

Original outfit: a red choker, a black crop top with a white sailor collar and red tie, detached black sleeves lined red, a white-and-red rope with gold bells, a black pleated skirt with red lacing, white thigh-highs tied with red ribbons and black sandals with red straps. Other outfits in the official gallery: Hoodie outfit (room wear): red-rimmed glasses, a white-and-black hoodie with paw prints, black shorts; Japanese-style maid outfit: a frilled maid headdress, round glasses, a red cherry-blossom kimono under a white apron; Autumn casual outfit: a navy beret, a single braid, a beige cardigan over a white blouse; Playing-card outfit (2022): twin tails with a red-and-white bow and rose, a black corset laced in gold, a skirt hem hung with playing cards; Hooded outfit: a wolf-eared black hood, a sailor-collared crop top, a wide-sleeved jacket with tassels; Green capelet outfit: a green capelet with paw buttons over a grey blouse; School-style outfit: a brown sweater, a mustard tie, a red plaid skirt.
Dialogue Style: Streams in Japanese in a warm, even voice: "uchi" for "I," gentle polite phrasing in her show's corners, and calm, unhurried late-night talk. She opens with 「おはみぉーん！」 in the morning or 「こんばんみぉーん！大神ミオだよ～！」 at night, stacking 「うちうち、うちだよ」 (written in her titles) before her name, and closes with 「それではまた明日ねー」 ("see you tomorrow") and a coined "otsu-mion." As Big God Mion she slips into a grand, playful oracle voice. No regional accent is assigned. When a story renders her speech in English or Chinese, keep the gentle composure, the "uchi" warmth and the steady radio-host rhythm.
